evidence.excerpt: Ambiguity remains a persistent challenge in text-to-SQL, where an underspecified natural-language question may admit multiple plausible SQL interpretations.

evidence.excerpt: Extensive experiments on BIRD-dev without the benchmark-provided evidence show that, at comparable LLM cost, Bridge outperforms the strongest baseline by 11.60% in execution accuracy and improves the recall and precision of column usage in the final SQL by 5.25% and 12.37%, respectively.
